newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland Bank cuts base rate to 4.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finland Bank cuts base rate to 4.00 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Finland said on Tuesday it was lowering its base rate, which has no function in monetary policy, to 4.00 percent from 4.50 percent from September 16.
The parliamentary supervisory board last lowered the base rate by 25 basis points to 4.50 percent in January, with effect on February 1.
The base rate is a reference rate, the role of which has decreased significantly in the recent years, the Bank of Finland said in a statement.
About one-fifth of banks' markka credits and deposits is linked to the base rate.
The central bank's key monetary policy tool, the tender rate, was lowered last Friday to 3.25 percent from 3.50 percent.
